'''Malai''' is a [[Seanchan]] ''[[damane]]''.

== Activities ==
She is able to tell fortunes of the weather. She tells [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]] that there will be no rain when she meets with the [[Dragon Reborn]].
